description_en: Queries the SSL servers that have been created by calling the DescribeSslVpnServers operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnServers接口查询已创建的SSL-VPN服务端
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-servers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-server-id vss-bp15j3du13gq1dgey0000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1on0xae9d771ggi0000 --name test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnServers

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the SSL server. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

SSL-VPN服务端所在的地域ID。

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL server belongs.

The SSL server belongs to the same resource group as the associated VPN gateway instance. You can call the [DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~) operation to query the resource group ID of the VPN gateway instance.
parameters.description_zh:
SSL-VPN服务端所属的资源组ID。

SSL-VPN服务端与其关联的VPN网关实例的资源组相同。您可以调用[DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~)接口查询VPN网关实例所属的资源组ID。
